item.text: {"summary":"The failures point to two printf-specific dynamic-field paths in include/fmt/printf.h. The supplied precision handler clamps every integral precision to at least 1, which accounts for zero and negative dynamic string and float precision, including the extra .0 in the large-exponent case. The width handler implementation is missing, so the negative-width failures cannot yet be tied to a concrete parsing or alignment behavior.","hypotheses":["printf_width_handler fails to convert a negative dynamic width into a positive width with left alignment; both sequential and positional widths use this path.","printf_precision_handler's minimum of 1 instead of 0 causes the four dynamic precision boundary failures and the extra fractional digit for the large fixed-format value."],"queries":["printf_width_handler","printf_precision_handler","get_arg(-1).visit(detail::printf_width_handler","specs.precision = static_cast<int>("],"reads":[{"path":"include/fmt/printf.h","line":95,"symbol":"printf_width_handler"},{"path":"include/fmt/printf.h","line":250,"symbol":"printf_arg_formatter"},{"path":"include/fmt/printf.h","line":400,"symbol":"vprintf"}],"ready":false}
